inlines.v: COLOGNE-EARTH, noun A kind of light bastard ocher, of a deep brown color, not a pure native fossil, but containing more vegetable than mineral matter; supposed to be the remains of wood long buried in the earth. It is an earthy variety of lignite or brown coal.
